content:
The losing positions are exactly the multiples of \(3\).

- From any non-multiple of \(3\), subtract \(1\) if \(N\equiv 1\pmod 3\), or subtract \(2\) if \(N\equiv 2\pmod 3\), leaving a multiple of \(3\).
- From a multiple of \(3\), subtracting any power of \(2\) leaves a non-multiple of \(3\), since \(2^n\not\equiv 0\pmod 3\).

Thus the first player wins for all \(N\) not divisible by \(3\).

There are \(\left\lfloor \frac{2019}{3}\right\rfloor = 673\) multiples of \(3\) from \(1\) to \(2019\), so the winning count is

\[
2019-673=1346.
\]

\[
\boxed{1346}
\]
